SMOUNT
0 - Not awaiting tape mounting
1 - Awaiting tape mounting signal
This indicator exists in the unit status table of a multi-
unit channel. It is set by the actuator, I-O assignment,
I-O change command, and special assignment. It indi-
cates that a channel signal can be expected from the
reading of a tape unit after mounting of a reel. The
indicator is tested and reset by the receptor, I-O change
command, and the actuator.
SREW
0 - Not rewind tape operation
1 - Rewind tape operation
This indicator exists in the unit status table of a multi-
unit channel. The indicator is set to 1 by the actuator
whenever a rewind operation, other than a setup opera-
tion, is in progress, and is tested and reset by the
receptor.
0 - Not initial mount status
SIMNT
1 - Initial mount status
This indicator is found in the unit status tables of a
multi-unit channel. The indicator shows that the first
mounting request has been made for program tape I-O
request, and the channel signal has not been received
indicating that the tape reel has been mounted. The
indicator is set by the I-O assignment package, and
sometimes by the I-O change and special assignment
programs. The indicator is tested and reset by the
receptor.
Same as Single Channel Status.
0 - Non-space operation
SSPACE
1 - Space operation
This indicator is found in the unit status table of a
multi-unit channel. It indicates that a spacing opera-
tion, other than a setup operation, is in progress on a
tape unit. The indicator is set by the actuator and
tested and reset by the receptor.
Same as Single Channel Status.
